title: Kestrel and the Echo
author: Isandro Sterling
blurb: Cyrus Whitlock, a decommissioned war android paying off its debts, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. But when a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must prove a massacre happened when every record says otherwise before the reactor finishes its countdown.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
